_comment: Test data for an MCP instance's seed vault (Emerald 0.1.3.x schema).
Rows are inserted table by table in the order of this file; within a table
in file order. Columns are filtered against PRAGMA table_info, so a column
the app drops later is skipped instead of failing the build.
@@chip(id,entryType,Label)@@  an internal-link chip as the editor writes it
@@img(name)@@                 absolute path of a generated test image in
the instance's images dir (see IMAGES there)
The data is shaped for the export features: a journal entry with paradigm,
banishing and meditation types, linked operations and wiki articles, inline
links, a custom property and a large image; entries that link onwards so
'including indirect' finds more than 'directly linked'; a Sigil operation
(excluded from export); trashed items; and an altar.

wiki_articles.title: Chaos Magic
wiki_articles.content:
Belief as a tool

Adopt a belief for as long as it is useful, then drop it. Practical starting point: @@chip(seed-wiki-sigil,wiki,Sigil Method)@@.

wiki_articles.title: Sigil Method
wiki_articles.content:
Steps

  1. Write the statement of intent.
  2. Strike repeated letters.
  3. Combine the rest into a glyph.

Time the charging with the @@chip(seed-wiki-moon,wiki,Moon Phases)@@.

Charging

Gnosis, then forget.

wiki_articles.title: Moon Phases
wiki_articles.content:
Eight phases, from new moon to waning crescent.

  • New moon — beginnings
  • Full moon — charging

wiki_articles.title: Banishing Ritual
wiki_articles.content: Clear the space before and after every working.

wiki_articles.title: Breath Meditation
wiki_articles.content: Count four in, hold four, four out, hold four.

operations.title: House Guardian
operations.content: A servitor that keeps the flat quiet. Fed after every @@chip(seed-wiki-banishing,wiki,Banishing Ritual)@@.

operations.title: Prosperity Sigil
operations.description: Standing sigil, charged at the full moon.
operations.intention_text: It is my will to keep steady work
operations.content: Sigils are excluded from export for now.

journal_entries.title: Full Moon Working
journal_entries.content:
Preparation

Followed the notes from @@chip(seed-journal-prep,journal,Preparation Notes)@@ and fed the @@chip(seed-op-guardian,operation,House Guardian)@@.

Working

Charged the glyph made with the @@chip(seed-wiki-sigil,wiki,Sigil Method)@@. The focus held well.

Afterwards

Closed with a banishing.

journal_entries.title: Preparation Notes
journal_entries.content: Candles, incense, the glyph drawn on paper. Plan for @@chip(seed-journal-full,journal,Full Moon Working)@@.
